process: the monarchy is hereditary; governor-general appointed by the monarch on the advice of the prime minister; following legislative elections, the governor-general appoints the leader of the majority party or majority coalition as prime minister; deputy prime minister also appointed by the governor-general
governmentType: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm
cabinet: Executive Council appointed by the governor-general on the recommendation of the prime minister
